strategy: End to end tests sign up real users on the app's database: signing up logs in, notes are saved, and a second user cannot see the first user's notes.

e2e_tests.description: Signing up logs the user in
A note is saved and survives a reload
e2e_tests.code:
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

async function signUp(page, tag) {
  await page.goto('/')
  await page.getByLabel('Email').fill(`vyskar.test+${Date.now()}${tag}@gmail.com`)
  await page.getByLabel('Password').fill('Test-password-123')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign up' }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Log out' })).toBeVisible()
}

test('saves a note', async ({ page }) => {
  const note = `Buy oat milk ${Date.now()}`
  const notes = page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Your notes' })
  await signUp(page, 'b')
  await page.getByLabel('New note').fill(note)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add note' }).click()
  await expect(notes.getByText(note)).toBeVisible()
  await page.reload()
  await expect(notes.getByText(note)).toBeVisible()
})

e2e_tests.description: A second user does not see the first user's note
e2e_tests.code:
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

async function signUp(page, tag) {
  await page.goto('/')
  await page.getByLabel('Email').fill(`vyskar.test+${Date.now()}${tag}@gmail.com`)
  await page.getByLabel('Password').fill('Test-password-123')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign up' }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Log out' })).toBeVisible()
}

test('keeps notes private', async ({ page }) => {
  const note = `Private plan ${Date.now()}`
  const notes = page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Your notes' })
  await signUp(page, 'c')
  await page.getByLabel('New note').fill(note)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add note' }).click()
  await expect(notes.getByText(note)).toBeVisible()
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Log out' }).click()
  await signUp(page, 'd')
  await expect(page.getByLabel('New note')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByText(note)).toHaveCount(0)
})
